topic: What happens when you stop exercising?
hook: What happens to your body when you suddenly stop exercising?
caption:
Fitness manchi alavatu, kaani konni sarlu pani ఒత్తిడి valla vyayamam aapestham. Mari ala aapesthe manassu meedha, shareeram meedha ela prabhavam chupisthundo telusa? Just 2 weeks lo muscle strength thaggi, energy level padipothundi. Kaani chinna roju vari nadaka ledha yoga tho manam malli active ga undocchu! 

Ee information mi friends ki kuda share cheyandi! 

#FitnessTelugu #HealthTips #WorkoutMotivation #StayActive #TeluguHealth #HeartHealth #HealthyHabits #WellnessJourney
poster_caption:
What actually happens inside your body when you take a workout break? 🏋️‍♂️

Fitness declines faster than it builds, but knowing the biological timeline helps you plan smarter recovery without losing your gains.

Here's the breakdown:
1️⃣ Days 10–14: VO2 Max and plasma volume drop rapidly, making cardio feel noticeably harder.
2️⃣ Weeks 2–4: Muscle mass decreases and insulin sensitivity drops as glycogen stores shrink.
3️⃣ The Good News: Muscle memory keeps trained myonuclei intact, helping you regain strength up to 2x faster!

📌 Save this guide for your daily health routine!
